title: Honey Vanilla Panna Cotta with Berries
description: A wobbling vanilla panna cotta sweetened with honey, served with macerated summer berries and an extra spoonful of honey.

ingredients.name: vanilla bean paste
ingredients.note: or 1 vanilla pod, split and scraped

steps.text: Put the cream, milk, honey, vanilla and salt in a saucepan and warm over low heat, stirring, until the honey dissolves — do not let it boil.
Meanwhile, soak the gelatine sheets in a bowl of cold water for 5 minutes, then squeeze dry.
Take the cream off the heat and stir in the gelatine until fully dissolved.
Strain the mixture through a fine sieve into a jug, then divide between six 150 ml glasses or dariole moulds.
Chill for at least 4 hours, ideally overnight, until softly set with a wobble.
Up to 30 minutes before serving, toss the berries with the lemon juice and a spoonful of honey.
To unmould, dip each mould in hot water for 5 seconds and invert onto a plate; otherwise serve straight from the glass, topped with the berries.

notesMarkdown:
## Setting

The wobble is the point — panna cotta should **tremble** when you tap the glass.
If it needs to be firmer for turning out, add an extra half sheet of gelatine.

> Gelatine sets at cool room temperature and melts at about 35°C, so work quickly
> once it is in the cream and never re-boil the mixture.

## Variations

- **Coffee:** steep 1 tbsp espresso grounds in the warm cream for 10 minutes before straining.
- **Citrus:** add the zest of one orange to the cream and serve with poached apricots.

## Storage

Keeps, covered, for up to 3 days in the fridge — making it the perfect
*make-ahead* dessert for entertaining.
